product_description: An intelligent autonomous workspace tool that helps cloud kitchen owners and restaurant chain manage their business orders, discounts, taxes, and live on delivery and schedule all at one place without human putting an effort to regularly update the data manually, or doing anything time to time interaction
target_audience: cloud kitchen operators owners, restaurant managers, and food franchise owners with knowledge of basic software tooling and computer interaction aged 15-45.
research_objectives: To understand how fine diner is helping business ease their workload of manual data management and additional labor for crm operator
To understand whether the other providers like swiggy, Zomato or etc are providing better features
To understand the current user needs and their problems that they still wait to be solved
